name: HR Nexus
description: Unified AI-powered HR agent combining Leave Management, HR Analytics, JD Generation, and End-to-End Recruitment Screening into a single intelligent assistant. Manage employee leaves, attendance, hiring pipelines, job descriptions, salary benchmarks, and team analytics — all through natural conversation.

skills.name: Leave Management
skills.description: Check balances, apply for leave, track approval, detect absenteeism patterns
examples: Check leave balance for Anjali Singh
Apply 3 days annual leave for Rahul from Dec 10-12
Who is on leave today?
Flag absenteeism risks in Engineering

skills.name: Attendance Tracking
skills.description: Mark attendance, get team availability, generate monthly reports
examples: Mark Priya Sharma present today
Show team availability for Engineering on 2025-03-15
Generate attendance report for December

skills.name: HR Analytics & Data
skills.description: Employee directory, salary details, departmental headcount, HR dashboard
examples: Show all Engineering employees
What is the payroll for Finance department?
Give me a full HR summary dashboard
Show salary of Anjali Singh

skills.name: Job Description Generator
skills.description: Write complete JDs for any role, benchmark salaries, format for job platforms
examples: Write a JD for a Senior Python Developer, remote, full-time
Generate a JD for ML intern, 3-month duration, Bangalore
Format this JD for LinkedIn
What salary should we offer a mid-level Data Scientist?

skills.name: Recruitment & Screening
skills.description: Score resumes, shortlist candidates, schedule interviews, send offer letters
examples: Show shortlisted candidates for FT-001
Score and screen all candidates for INT-001
Schedule interview for CAND-005 on March 20
Send offer letter to CAND-008 with salary 40L
Show the recruitment dashboard
